name: HK416 16in Heavy Barrel Realism Compatibility
teaser: Do you hate the front sight on the HK416? Do you like the Realism mod? Do I have good news for you.
description_html:
I hate the vanilla 16.5 inch HK 416 barrel. Yeah I know the sights flips down in use, but it still looks ugly, and you can’t use the nice handguards when using it. Good thing NORVINSK_EVANGELION made a new barrel that doesn’t have those issues.

I just quickly cobbled together this singular text file to make the barrel fit in with Realism. I eyeballed the stats to be somewhere between the 20 inch and the 16.5 inch barrels, with slightly better accuracy but slightly increased weight. But the main benefit is the lack of that ugly front sight and the ability to use long handguards.

For installation, you obviously need HK416 16in Heavy barrel and SPT Realism Mod. Just drag and drop the contents of this mod’s archive into your SPT folder.
